commands.author: sunlit-deng

target.title: fix: support baseURL alias in memory embedding provider config resolution
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

When users configure `models.providers.*.baseURL` (capital `URL`) for a provider, the strict schema used to reject/drop that alias instead of exposing the canonical `baseUrl` field downstream.

Fixes #93396.

## Changes

| File | Change |
|------|--------|
| `src/config/zod-schema.core.ts` | Accept `models.providers.*.baseURL`, normalize to canonical `baseUrl`, delete the alias before downstream code reads the provider config, and reject configs that set both spellings. |
| `src/config/types.models.ts` | Add `baseURL` to the input config type as a compatibility alias. |
| `src/config/schema.hints.ts` | Walk Zod pipes while collecting schema hint paths so transformed provider schemas keep sensitive URL metadata for `baseUrl` and its `baseURL` alias. |
| `src/config/schema.help.ts` | Add help text for the `baseURL` alias field. |
| `src/config/schema.labels.ts` | Add display label for the `baseURL` alias field. |
| `src/config/schema.test.ts` | Covers `baseURL` normalization, alias deletion, duplicate-spelling rejection, and sensitive URL metadata on the alias path. |
| `src/config/schema.hints.test.ts` | Covers discovery of the `models.providers.*.baseURL` sensitive URL hint path. |
| `src/config/redact-snapshot.test.ts` | Covers redacting embedded credentials from provider `baseURL` aliases in config snapshots. |
| `packages/net-policy/src/redact-sensitive-url.ts` | Treats `models.providers.*.baseURL` as a sensitive URL config path alongside `baseUrl`. |
| `packages/net-policy/src/redact-sensitive-url.test.ts` | Covers the alias in the shared sensitive URL path predicate. |
| `src/agents/memory-search.test.ts` | Strengthens `baseURL` coverage so schema-normalized config resolves the built-in OpenAI memory adapter and its default model. |
| `docs/gateway/config-tools.md` | Document `baseURL` as a compatibility alias normalized to `baseUrl`. |
| `docs/.generated/config-baseline.sha256` | Refresh baseline hash after schema changes. |

## Real behavior proof

**Behavior addressed:** `models.providers.*.baseURL` is accepted by the production schema, normalized to `baseUrl`, then used by the real OpenAI memory embedding path to call the configured `/v1/embeddings` endpoint.

**Exact commands run after fix:**

```bash
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/config/schema.test.ts src/agents/memory-search.test.ts
git diff --check
PNPM_CONFIG_VERIFY_DEPS_BEFORE_RUN=false node --import tsx scripts/generate-config-doc-baseline.ts --check
./node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check packages/net-policy/src/redact-sensitive-url.ts packages/net-policy/src/redact-sensitive-url.test.ts src/config/schema.test.ts src/config/schema.hints.test.ts src/config/redact-snapshot.test.ts src/config/zod-schema.core.ts src/config/types.models.ts src/config/schema.hints.ts src/config/schema.labels.ts src/config/schema.help.ts
./node_modules/.bin/oxlint --tsconfig config/tsconfig/oxlint.core.json packages/net-policy/src/redact-sensitive-url.ts packages/net-policy/src/redact-sensitive-url.test.ts src/config/zod-schema.core.ts src/config/types.models.ts src/config/schema.hints.ts src/config/schema.labels.ts src/config/schema.help.ts src/config/schema.test.ts src/config/schema.hints.test.ts src/config/redact-snapshot.test.ts
node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p tsconfig.core.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/core.tsbuildinfo
node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p test/tsconfig/tsconfig.core.test.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/core-test.tsbuildinfo
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/config/schema.test.ts src/agents/memory-search.test.ts
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/config/schema.hints.test.ts src/config/redact-snapshot.test.ts packages/net-policy/src/redact-sensitive-url.test.ts
```

**After-fix evidence:**

```text
[test] passed 2 Vitest shards in 57.33s

git diff --check: passed
OK docs/.generated/config-baseline.sha256
oxfmt: All matched files use the correct format.
oxlint: passed (no errors)
tsgo core: passed
tsgo core-test: passed

[test] passed 2 Vitest shards in 57.33s

src/config/schema.test.ts: 57 passed
src/agents/memory-search.test.ts: 38 passed

[test] passed 2 Vitest shards in 5.40s

src/config/schema.hints.test.ts: 11 passed
src/config/redact-snapshot.test.ts + packages/net-policy/src/redact-sensitive-url.test.ts: 73 passed
```

The `baseURL` alias is accepted in production config, normalized to `baseUrl`, and downstream provider resolution works correctly (memory adapter → configured model → `/v1/embeddings` endpoint).
